display.purpose: Pokémon name on the detail screen.

row-title.purpose: List names, battle names, button labels.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Single full-width cobalt action; dims when pressed or disabled.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #2B59FF; color: #FFFFFF; min-height: 52px; width: 100%; border: none; border-radius: 14px; font: 600 17px -apple-system, Roboto, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover, .ds-btn-primary:active { opacity: 0.55; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2B59FF; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: List Row
components.description: 72px grouped row: sprite on a recessed disc, name, dex number.
components.css: .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; height: 72px; padding: 0 8px; background: #FFFFFF; border-radius: 16px; font-family: -apple-system, Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-row:active { opacity: 0.6; } .ds-disc { width: 56px; height: 56px; border-radius: 50%; background: #F5F5F7; } .ds-name { flex: 1; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 600; color: #111318; text-transform: capitalize; } .ds-num { font-size: 15px; color: #6B7080; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; padding-right: 8px; }

components.name: Type Chip
components.description: Pill in the Pokémon's type color with luminance-picked text.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; background: #EE8130; color: #111318; font: 600 14px -apple-system, Roboto, sans-serif; padding: 6px 14px; border-radius: 999px; }

components.name: Stat Row
components.description: Label, value and type-colored bar inside the stats card.
components.css: .ds-stat { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-family: -apple-system, Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; } .ds-stat-l { width: 84px; color: #6B7080; } .ds-stat-v { width: 36px; text-align: right; font-weight: 600; color: #111318; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-track { flex: 1; height: 8px; border-radius: 4px; background: #E4E5EA; overflow: hidden; } .ds-bar { width: 19%; height: 100%; border-radius: 4px; background: #EE8130; }

components.name: HP Bar
components.description: Battle HP track with status-colored fill.
components.css: .ds-hp { height: 8px; border-radius: 4px; background: #E4E5EA; overflow: hidden; } .ds-hp-fill { width: 70%; height: 100%; border-radius: 4px; background: #34C759; transition: width 450ms; }

narrative.overview:
The interface is a neutral, silent wall and each Pokémon is the work hung on it. Surfaces are cool off-white (light) or near-black (dark); the only expressive color on screen is the type color of the Pokémon being shown, and the only brand color is a single cobalt tint reserved for actions.

Density is comfortable and thumb-first: 72 pt list rows, 52 pt buttons, 44 pt icon targets. Type is the platform system face on a short, clear scale. Icons are single-stroke Ionicons outline glyphs. Light and dark are both first-class.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral canvas, grouped rounded cards, no shadows.
Type color is the only expressive hue; cobalt is the only brand hue.
System type, weights 400/600/700, tabular numerals for numbers.
Feedback is immediate: pressed dimming, haptics, animated bars, hit shake.

rules.name: The Type-Only Color Rule
rules.body: Outside actions and HP status, hue comes from the Pokémon's type and nowhere else. A new surface that needs color derives it from the subject, never invents an accent.

rules.name: The One Tint Rule
rules.body: Cobalt marks things you can press. It is not decoration and not a second type color.

rules.name: The Tabular Number Rule
rules.body: Dex numbers (#001), stat values and HP counts use tabular numerals so columns do not jitter.

rules.name: The Flat Rule
rules.body: Surfaces never cast shadows. If something must separate, change its tone, not its elevation.

dos: Do read every color from useTheme() and TYPE_COLORS; support light and dark from the same token names.
Do tint detail surfaces from the Pokémon's first type: 18% wash for the hero, full strength for bars.
Do use onColor() for text on any type-colored fill.
Do keep touch targets at least 44px and give every pressable an accessibility role and label.
Do use Ionicons outline glyphs and system type.
donts: Don't add shadows or gradients; cards are flat tonal fills.
Don't use cobalt for non-interactive decoration or type colors for actions.
Don't introduce a second brand accent or a red cartridge-style frame.
Don't hardcode neutral hex values in screens; add them to the theme.
